Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression is redundant because the time noun already identifies the historical period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 靠墓地的家：靠近墓地的家里，The verb phrase needs a clear location: this wording specifies that the home is near the cemetery and that they live inside it. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，This action means the mother takes the child with her when moving; the original wording suggests that they move together as equal participants. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，This refers to one additional or different city; this use requires the word meaning “another,” rather than the form used to distinguish other people or things. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：一个叫孟子的小男孩和他的妈妈，At first mention, introduce the child with a name and identity so the reader does not need prior knowledge of the characters. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得自己没有钱，The affected person is the same as the subject earlier in the sentence, so the reflexive form avoids unnecessarily repeating the name in the same sentence. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在：住在，Living in a place is a state here, not a completed action, so it does not take 了; the location follows 在. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，A daily routine uses the zero aspect form rather than 了, which marks a completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，For a completed move, 了 follows the resultative/directional part 到, not the main verb 搬. [teacher rule: le_placement]

items.reason: 古代已经是时间名词，再加的时候重复，教师明确要求用“在古代”。
“靠墓地”不如“靠近墓地”合适；但放回原句后“住了在”仍然错误。
“跟孩子搬家”可以正确表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，并非错误。
这里表示“另一个城市”，应使用“另一个”而不是“别一个”。
人物首次出现时需要对孟子作简短介绍，避免读者无从得知其身份。
“害得孟母没有钱”重复名字并不构成错误，“自己”只是可选的改写。
“住了在”中“了”的使用和地点结构都不对，但“住在”单独仍缺少地点补足语。
“每天”表示日常习惯，祭拜不应使用完成体“了”。
趋向补语结构应为“搬到了”，但完整原句改后仍保留“别一个城市”的错误。
